neighbours.label: The opening piece of a katakana word that the tokenizer splits into several pieces, loanword, name or native/onomatopoeia (e.g. ワ in ワクワク, ア in アドレナリン, スペ in スペイン, カ in カマキリ), in Japanese or mixed text. Weaker (about 0.2-0.5 of max) on common katakana words that are one whole token (テレビ, バス, コーヒー) and on Korean Hangul text of any kind; kanji and hiragana words in the same slot stay low (about 0.1-0.3).
neighbours.short: opening piece of a split katakana word
